name: Barbell Bent-over Row
steps: Hold the bar overhand and hinge at the hips with knees softly bent.
Maintain a steady trunk angle and let the bar hang below the shoulders.
Pull the bar toward the lower ribs.
Lower to straight arms without changing the trunk position.
cues: Keep the neck aligned with the back.
mistakes: Standing up to lift each rep.
Rounding the lower back under load.
breathing: Exhale while rowing; inhale on the return while maintaining the brace.
